name: Color Spray
description: Level 1 Illusion (Bard, Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: Self Components: V, S, M (a pinch of colorful sand) Duration: Instantaneous You launch a dazzling array of flashing, colorful light. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone originating from you must succeed on a Resolve saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn.
